title: Static Domed-Shield Telson Horseshoe Crab
description: One new complete stylised horseshoe-crab-like exterior: a broad curved front prosomal shield rises into a low dome with two extended rear corners; a distinct narrower spiny hind shield overlaps beneath its rear margin and ends in one long tapered three-sided telson. Five pairs of short bent underside legs have small finite resting tips; two small dorsal eyes sit on the shield. All complete outlines, dome surfaces, leg paths and posterior parts are newly authored, not old crab pincers removed and a tail attached, nor a fossil slab relief extracted. One opaque static animal prop, zero scenes. No exact species, ventral gill/internal anatomy, locomotion, sting, dangerousness, rig, animation, stability or interaction claim.
